identity.title: Annual Report for Standard Air Contaminant Discharge Permit 26-2841-ST-01, Reporting Year 2025

scan.summary: This is an annual report submitted to Oregon DEQ under the Standard Air Contaminant Discharge Permit, covering operations at the Portland facility for calendar year 2025. It documents throughput across three production lines, scrubber performance logs, carbon adsorption unit maintenance, and reports one equipment failure deviation. The report is required by permit condition and confirms the facility's operational status and compliance monitoring for the reporting period.
scan.freshness_note: This report covers 2025 and was signed February 10, 2026 and received February 12, 2026. It is now approximately seven months old. No fresher annual report would be expected until the 2026 report is due in early 2027.

Quarterly inspections under Condition 3.2 were carried out on March 27, June 26, September 25 and
December 18, 2025, and are recorded in the scrubber maintenance file.
3. Carbon adsorption unit C-1 (Condition 3.3)
The carbon in C-1 was replaced on March 14, 2025 (Calgon Filtrasorb 400, 1,800 pounds, by Northwest
Carbon Services). Weekly detector-tube checks at the C-1 outlet were carried out every week in 2025 with
no breakthrough detected. The next scheduled replacement is on or before March 14, 2026.
4. Deviations and excess emissions (Conditions 5.1 and 5.2)
One deviation. On August 22, 2025 the S-2 recirculation pump failed at 14:10; the caustic repackaging
line was stopped within four minutes and remained down until the pump was replaced on August 24. No
product was repackaged on the caustic line while the scrubber was out of service. The Department was
notified by email on August 23, 2025 and a written report was submitted on September 2, 2025 (DEQ
reference DEV-2025-0913).
Opacity: no visible emissions above 20 percent were observed at any permitted source in 2025.
I certify that the information in this report is true, accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.
